dash_summary_scope.description: Clarifies the scope of the summary tiles on the dashboard overview tab.

dash_what_we_measure.description: Title of the panel that discloses exactly which metrics can be observed in a published extension.

diag_integration_note.message: Features that need infrastructure we do not operate are marked clearly instead of being simulated.

error_forbidden_sender.message: This message type is not allowed from a web page.

error_invalid_payload.message: Rejected a message with an invalid payload.

error_no_response.message: The background service did not answer.

error_service_worker.message: The extension is starting up. Try again in a moment.

error_storage_full.message: Local storage is full. Clear data in the Privacy tab.

error_update_failed.message: The update failed. The previous list was kept.

extension_description.message: Blocks phishing, malware, scams, trackers and ads. Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no data collection.
extension_description.description: Chrome caps description at 132 characters. Store limits are enforced by tests/unit/store-limits.test.ts.

extension_description_long.message: VOLTRIS Browser Shield analyses every navigation locally, combining verified threat feeds with Unicode, impersonation and URL-structure heuristics. Blocks known malicious destinations, warns about deceptive links, reduces tracking and flags suspicious downloads. Everything runs on your device: no browsing history, passwords, cookies or tokens are collected or sent anywhere.
extension_description_long.description: Long description for the store listing.

extension_name.description: Extension name shown in the browser UI.

extension_short_name.description: Chrome caps short_name at 12 characters and prefers no spaces. The full name still appears in the store and in chrome://extensions.

hover_known_malicious.message: VOLTRIS: this link points to a known malicious destination.

hover_suspicious.message: VOLTRIS: this link shows signs of impersonation or deception.

lang_auto.description: Language picker option that follows the browser, the default.

lang_label.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the language picker in the popup header.

lists_data_only.message: Only data is downloaded. No code is fetched or executed.

metric_detections.description: Metric label: verdicts produced by the URL analysis engine.

metric_detections_hint.message: Pages our analysis engine flagged as suspicious, whether or not a rule blocked them.

metric_download_warnings.description: Metric label: risky downloads we warned about.

metric_download_warnings_hint.message: Downloads we checked against the browser's own dangerous-file lists.

metric_observed_blocks.description: Metric label: top-level navigations observed being blocked.

metric_observed_blocks_hint.message: Counted from a blocked navigation the browser actually reported, in published builds as well as local ones.
metric_observed_blocks_hint.description: Explains how the blocked-page counter is obtained.

metric_rules_installed_hint.message: How much protection is installed. This is a state, not a count of how many times it fired.
metric_rules_installed_hint.description: Prevents the rule count from being read as a block count.

metric_subresource_blocks_hint.message: Not measurable in a published extension. The browser exposes this counter only to unpacked, development builds, so we report no number rather than an invented one.
metric_subresource_blocks_hint.description: Explains why the sub-resource counter is unavailable, instead of showing a false zero.

opt_block_third_party_only_hint.message: Recommended. Keeps first-party site functionality intact.

opt_credentials_intro.message: Some sources require your own API key. We never ship a third-party key and never claim an integration works without one.

opt_download_action_hint.message: Cancelling uses the browser downloads API before the file is written. It never replaces the browser's own download protections.

opt_hover_warnings_hint.message: Shows a small badge when the link destination carries relevant risk.

opt_phishing_engine_hint.message: Detects impersonation, Unicode homographs and unusual URL structures. Produces warnings, never automatic verdicts of malice.

opt_protection_enabled_hint.message: Master switch. When off, nothing is blocked and no page is analysed.

opt_scam_page_hint.message: Looks at page structure only. Never reads what you type or your passwords.

opt_store_full_urls.message: Store full URLs in the event history

opt_store_full_urls_hint.message: Off by default. When on, query strings and fragments are still removed.

opt_store_history_hint.message: Capped list of recent security events, stored on this device only.

opt_warn_dangerous_ext_hint.message: Informational. Legitimate installers exist, so this never blocks by itself.

perm_host_access_hint.message: Required to evaluate URLs and to block requests. URLs stay on your device.

perm_intro.message: VOLTRIS requests only the permissions below, each tied to a shipped feature.

perm_no_justification.message: No justification recorded for this permission. Please report it.
perm_no_justification.description: Fallback shown if the manifest ever declares a permission the justification table does not cover.

perm_unused.message: Declared but not used by any active feature

permission_alarms.message: Check for threat list updates in the background.
permission_alarms.description: Justification shown in the permission diagnostics table.

permission_dnr.message: Block network requests without reading page content.

permission_scripting.message: Re-run the page analysis when you ask for it.

permission_tabs.message: Read the address of the current tab.

permission_webnavigation.message: Notice when a page we block fails to load, so the block can be counted and explained.
permission_webnavigation.description: Justification shown in the permission diagnostics table.

popup_no_site_hint.message: Open a page to analyse it.

popup_rules_active.description: Popup stat tile: number of installed blocking rules.

privacy_clear_intro.message: Removes data stored by the extension on this device.

privacy_intro.message: VOLTRIS Browser Shield is local-first. There is no account, no telemetry and no server.

privacy_limits_body.message: The extension cannot guarantee that every malicious site is detected. Threat feeds only cover URLs that have already been reported. It does not scan file contents, cannot inspect certificate history, cannot follow server-side redirects before they happen, and never promises absolute safety. Absence of a detection is not a guarantee of safety.

privacy_limits_intro.message: Stated plainly, because honest limits build more trust than bold claims.

privacy_network.message: Downloads threat list data from the providers listed in the Lists tab. Nothing else leaves your device.

privacy_stored_4.message: A capped list of recent security events (domains only by default)

privacy_stored_5.message: Threat list data downloaded from the sources listed in the Lists tab

reason_credential_brand_on_lookalike.message: Authentication brand on a look-alike host

reason_unicode_mixed_script.message: Mixed Unicode scripts in the domain

resource_feedback_hint.message: Counts come from events the browser actually reported.
resource_feedback_hint.description: Short note under the block accounting capability row.

resource_hover_hint.message: Shows a discreet warning when a link carries relevant risk.

resource_scams_hint.message: Checks page structure. Never reads what you type.

sites_scope_all_hint.message: Stops every block for this site, including malware. Use with caution.

sites_scope_privacy_hint.message: Recommended. Malware and phishing protection stays active.

sites_scope_threats_hint.message: Keeps the site itself blocked for top-level navigation, but lets sub-requests through.

verdict_not_analyzed_hint.message: There was not enough coverage or data to reach a conclusion.

verdict_suspicious_hint.message: Heuristic signals were detected. This is not a proof of malice.
